text:
Elaine: Hey team :wave: Quick sync on SI co-sell rules of engagement for the RackScale partnership. Putting a proposed lightweight process here so ops can map leads cleanly. TL;DR: account mapping sheet + lead-handoff form + 72h response SLA from the SI owner. Link to sheet: https://redwood.work/sheets/rackscale-si-mapping

Matt: +1. Need clarity on deal ownership when SI brings the opportunity vs when we source it. propose 60/40 credit split for FY26 quota credit. Is that acceptable?

Raj: For technical ownership, SE handoffs need to happen within 24h. I'll own initial scoping call for any POC under $50k. Otherwise the SI SE should lead. Suggest adding 'SE owner' column in the mapping.

Sofia: Finance/RevOps note: please use the lead-handoff form so pipeline-bot tags the opp correctly. We require account mapping to include: account id, legal entity, SI primary contact, SI account owner, source tag, expected ARR. I'll paste the minimal columns:

```
account_name,account_id,crm_owner,si_partner,si_owner_email,lead_source,expected_annual_value,roeng_accepted (yes/no)
```

Elaine: Thanks. Rules of engagement draft:
1) No cold outreach to mapped accounts by Redwood reps for 14 days after SI notifies (unless pre-approved).
2) If SI sourced lead, SI gets initial owner credit and 60/40 credit split for quota.
3) Joint account plan required for any opp > $100k.
4) All handoffs via the form -> pipeline-bot will tag and assign.

Jen: One edge case — if customer explicitly requests Redwood-only procurement and wants us to run the deal, do we still honor 60/40? We should have an escalation path.

Elaine: Good call. Add clause: customer-requested single vendor overrides default split; RevOps to record exception reason. Also add arbitration: Partnerships + Sales + SI rep decide within 5 business days.

Matt: Can we get a simple shared dashboard? pipeline-bot already posts to #sales-daily but need SI-specific view.

Sofia: I'll set up a filtered view in the partner dashboard and give read access to the SI PMs. Expect it by EOD Thursday.

pipeline-bot: New lead form submitted: https://redwood.work/forms/si-handoff?id=4823 - assigned to Matt (Sales)

Elaine: Awesome — will iterate. If no objections, I'll send this as a one-page SOP to the SI and cc sales leadership. :thumbsup:
